with l as (select l.link_id, a.issue_key ak, a.project_key ap, b.issue_key bk, b.project_key bp from model.issue_link l join model.issue a on a.issue_key=l.from_issue_key join model.issue b on b.issue_key=l.to_issue_key where a.project_key<>b.project_key),
e as (select ak k, ap p from l union select bk, bp from l),
c as (select p id, count(*) value from e group by p),
t as (select id, value, rank() over (order by value desc) r from c)
select id, value from t where r<=5 order by value desc

with l as (select l.link_id, a.issue_key ak, a.project_key ap, b.issue_key bk, b.project_key bp from model.issue_link l join model.issue a on a.issue_key=l.from_issue_key join model.issue b on b.issue_key=l.to_issue_key where a.project_key<>b.project_key),
top as (select unnest(array['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM']) p)
select link_id, ak issue from l where ap in (select p from top)
union select link_id, bk from l where ap in (select p from top) or bp in (select p from top)
union select link_id, ak from l where bp in (select p from top)
